usage: cox dev commands [-h] [--target {all,pages,readme}] [--pages-dir PAGES_DIR]
                        [--readme README]
                        {render}

positional arguments:
  {render}              the only action: render

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --target {all,pages,readme}
  --pages-dir PAGES_DIR
                        where the slash-command pages are written; without it only the README is
                        rendered
  --readme README
